records.text: The friend of the Fort Huachuca poster confirmed that the post claiming Erika Kirk was seen at the base was real.

appearances.snippet: And then a second person who was friends with that individual who was formerly stationed as well at Fort Huachuca said, yeah, that post actually happened and there's more.

verification.notes: This is a private friend's confirmation of an anonymous/deleted post. Neither the friend nor the original poster can be independently authenticated from current public sources.
